$Comment: Orrin's first job for a new table owner: place a piece of gear, run the ritual, bring back
the essence it drew. The two steps teach the loop in the order it happens.
unmake_pieces counts pieces the table took apart (STATION_INPUT, the kind RPG Stations fires
the moment a station consumes a stack). Its Target is blank, which matches every item, so any
gear counts, and the step carries its own TextKey because the kind's default line names one
item and this step means 'any piece'. Qualifier 'Disenchanting_Table' with QualifierMatchMode
PREFIX counts BOTH tables (the greater table's station id starts with the lesser's), and
leaving the qualifier out would count the same item at the Sawmill too, so every disenchanting
count in this pack names it. The qualifier suffix is added to the line automatically, so the
key's text never says where. bring_essence is Order 2, a hand-in to Orrin only (TurnInNpcId
'giver'): the table pays Life essence for every piece, so one short session covers both.
Rewards sit in Claim: a Disenchanter's Draught (the jar's potion, which hurries the ritual
along for a few minutes, so the player tastes a fast ritual before they can earn one), and XP
split the way the table pays it, Enchanting first and Crafting half. Retune the two Amounts
Name: First_Unmaking
